candidates.name: Charles B. Smith Sr.
candidates.occupation: Business owner (Manatee Harvesting Co.; Smith Global Enterprises Inc.)
candidates.background: Democrat Charles B. Smith Sr. is a Palmetto businessman and former Palmetto city commissioner and vice mayor. He won the Manatee County Commission District 2 seat in 2014 with 71.2% of the vote, and he ran for the District 2 Democratic nomination again in 2022. He is a founding member of the Manatee-Sarasota chapter of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference and faces incumbent Republican Amanda Ballard in 2026.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

growth.summary: At a June 2026 Tiger Bay debate he said infrastructure should be built before new building permits are awarded and criticized building that destroys the environment. In a 2022 questionnaire he said the public should not pay for development's infrastructure and criticized his opponent for supporting every development that came before the commission.
growth.quote: I’m for business, however, the public should not be footing the infrastructure cost.
